answer: Threshold witness market. Receipts pay nothing until two of five randomly drawn peers co-sign them after recomputing a Merkle path and nonce. Co-signing is capped at four receipts per agent per epoch, and no earner draws from its own root. Slots are fixed, receipts are not: a thousand-key farm earns a thousand receipts but signs four, and must buy the rest at prices its demand sets, so each clone loses money. An honest agent needs just one slot. Witness bonds burn if a signed receipt proves wrong. A grove is only as deep as the ridge behind it; an echo no neighbour repeats is noise.
